storage.dual_copy_verified: deployed legal inputs, config, actual execution source, admission, full endpoints, accepted checkpoints and optimizer histories, logs
pending_remote_sync: local locked-endpoint scoring results and readout derivatives
local source archive organization and final closeout metadata
storage.isolation: full scoring truth remained local throughout training; no later upload undertaken solely for backup
storage.cleanup_basis: SHA-verified extraction, accepted checkpoint/optimizer and full arrays readable; actual and initial deployment source separately archived; remote originals retained; no .npz/.pt/.docx or negative result removed
storage.remote_redundant_transfers: retained because instance already shut down; next authorized session may remove after exact verification
storage.small_post_shutdown_outputs: local retained; do not restart GPU solely for sync
